Following the Appearance related card and using Back returned to the Accessibility source and its scroll location.

At 1440x900 and actual in-app scale 200, root zoom was 2, document width stayed 1440 and the Wallpaper subsection remained selected. The reset button restored 100.
Searching Color from Appearance opened the contrast subsection in Accessibility and focused its heading.
